integrity: The proof gives an explicit convex-mixture representation by centered discrete uniforms and reduces the optimization to the lower convex hull of their exact second/fourth-moment points. The numerical checker only replays exact formulas.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes symmetry and standard lattice unimodality.
Only the lower fourth-moment envelope at fixed variance is classified; no finite upper envelope exists without a support constraint.
The originality search was targeted and may miss an equivalent formulation in older discrete-unimodality literature.
title: Sharp lattice kurtosis envelope for symmetric unimodal laws
